summary: The regex test compares a string to a regex using Python's match, fullmatch or search functions.
questions: How do I test a string against a regex anywhere in it?
Which regex test lets me choose match, search or fullmatch?

answer_card.title: regex test
answer_card.answer_md: `string is regex(pattern)` matches using Python `search` by default; set `match_type` to `match` or `fullmatch` to change.
